After every 5 draws, if the number of apples drawn so far is at least 4 (counting every draw, even if an item is returned later), you return 2 uniformly random drawn items from the most recent block to the bag and continue; otherwise you discard the last 2 drawn items permanently. You stop after 40 total draws. What is the expected number of apples drawn?

title: Two-urn transfer with conditional switch of transfer direction

You perform 6 rounds: in each round, draw one ball from each urn (without replacement within each urn), compare colors; if they match you transfer 3 balls from Urn 1 to Urn 2 uniformly at random from Urn 1’s remaining contents, otherwise transfer 3 balls from Urn 2 to Urn 1. After 6 rounds, you draw 6 balls from Urn 1. Compute the probability of getting exactly 0 red.

title: Stratified sampling with unequal weights and post-stratum adjustment
text: A population has two strata: Stratum A size 105 with mean -2.37 and variance 5.11, and Stratum B size 230 with mean 7.98 and variance 10.49. Within each stratum, observations are i.i.d. normal with the given mean and variance. You sample 23 from A and 29 from B without replacement. Then you discover a measurement bias: all A observations should be increased by -4.87 only if the overall sample mean is below 3.47, otherwise no correction is applied. Compute the expected corrected overall mean.
